信号按后续成交撮合，委托不跨时段；每日按填写的结算价结算，持仓和均线历史续接，不: Signals fill on subsequent trades; orders do not cross sessions. Each day uses the supplied settlement price, carrying positions and moving-average history without forced liquidation.
时段结束时刻不包含在内，结算发生在当日末时段结束时。系统不推断节假日；保证金、手: Session ends are exclusive. Settlement occurs at the end of the final session each day. Holidays are not inferred; you supply margin, fees and settlement sources.
按实际日线观测计算收盘价动量，不补齐缺失日期。每个评价分区至少需要 30 个有效: Close momentum uses observed daily bars without filling missing dates. Each evaluation partition requires at least 30 labelled samples.

保证金与手续费由你填写，不代表交易所规则。委托在下一根 K 线以保守价格撮合，每: Margin and fees are your inputs, not exchange rules. Orders fill conservatively on the next bar, up to 10% of that bar's volume; each trading day settles at the daily settlement price.
选择从数据源下载的一个或多个合约的 K 线创建模拟账户，组合共用一个资金账户。会: Create a simulated account from data-source bars of one or more contracts; the portfolio shares one cash account. The session is written to a dedicated directory on the trading service's machine and recovers after restarts.
委托在本合约的下一根 K 线撮合：买单在最低价不高于限价时按开盘价与限价中较低者: Orders match on the next bar of their own contract: a buy fills at the lower of the open and the limit when the low is at or below the limit, sells symmetrically; each bar fills at most 10% of its volume, allocated in order of submission. There is no order book, slippage or forced liquidation model. Unrealized losses reduce available funds; unrealized gains do not add opening capacity. Storage keeps the datasets and the operation log.
每个合约按自己的 K 线收盘价计算均线，仅做多或空仓；信号在该合约的下一根 K: Each contract computes moving averages from its own bar closes, long or flat only; signals match on that contract's next bar and each trading day settles at the data-source settlement price. At the end unfilled orders are cancelled; positions are not closed automatically.
结算价来自数据源日线；每个交易日所有合约回放完成后一起结算，再进入下一交易日。勾: Settlement prices come from data-source daily bars; each trading day settles all contracts together after their replay completes, before the next trading day begins. With automatic day-end settlement, the same settlement command is sent when each trading day ends.
